hypothesis: Y033 quorum2 reduced churn in the frozen four known drift regimes. Test zero-retuning transfer to new drift rates and late-shock episodes using identical memory capacity and current-graph-only rules.
freeze: All new drift regimes, exact displacement schedule, policy arms, split, thresholds and sampling are preregistered before scientific first use. Quorum threshold 2 remains fixed and may not be tuned based on Y034 heldout.
population: Inherited Y033 seven active, sixteen motif identities/cells, at most nine inactive cached assignments, four-way collision and radius-two neighborhood, eight episodes per seed.
policies: matched_sham no cache read, matched writes
full read any previously observed legal cached assignment
quorum2 use legal prior assignments only with >=2 distinct eligible keys
quorum3 use only when >=3 distinct eligible keys
primary: All four regimes x policies x 16 heldout seeds, actual returning-key assignment churn, legal preference counts, cache write and key parity, search calls, full per-seed outcomes.
classification: QUORUM_ROBUST iff quorum2 heldout churn<=full heldout churn in ALL three new regimes, is strictly lower in >=1 new regime, and under old drift1 retains >=70% of full's sham-relative saving. MIXED if a new-regime strict improvement occurs but robust rule fails. NO_TRANSFER otherwise. Preserve adverse and no-effect outcomes.
controls: No future-state, no evaluator-only history to policy, no labels/oracle to action
Same bounded cache writes/key trajectories across all arms
Freeze parent+source blobs, archive first-use original evidence, final full pytest regression
claim_limit: Synthetic matching cache quorum under unseen geometry; no semantics or autonomous cognition.
